$comment: Ground truth for the eval corpus. The corpus files carry NO labels — all expectations live here, so a run cannot cheat by reading the answer. score.cjs matches a run's findings.json against these entries by file basename. 'keywords' is an informational class-match hint, not part of the pass/fail metric.
